known_before_contract.deep_tail: Marginal depths 4-10 exceed activation nulls; depths 1-3 do not.
known_before_contract.route_lag: Residual dependence remains positive at stop-number lags 7-9.
known_before_contract.scalar_state: Uniform all-stop taxon-night scalar state is too coherent.
known_before_contract.historical_sites: Deep k>=4 activity preferentially aligns with recurrent strong-chorus SiteIDs in a post-hoc diagnostic.
known_before_contract.exact_coordinate_distance: Previously attempted exact-distance profile is non-authoritative because of coordinate transcription errors.

population.base: Exactly the ERA5-weather-eligible strictly-prior-history focal pairs used by the strongest fixed-q comparator.
population.species_cluster: Taxa acoustically silent at all ten drier-survey stops and active at >=1 wetter-survey stop.
population.secondary: All k>=2 clusters for span and pairwise-lag descriptions; k>=1 for components.

metrics.span: max(active StopNumber)-min(active StopNumber); zero for k=1.
metrics.holes: span+1-k; number of inactive stop-number positions inside the active-set hull.
metrics.components: Number of contiguous runs of active StopNumbers.
metrics.mean_pairwise_lag: Mean absolute StopNumber difference among active-stop pairs; zero for k<2.

primary_endpoint.statistic: Mean observed holes minus exact-k fixed-q conditional expectation across eligible clusters.
primary_endpoint.biological_interpretation: Deep activation is spatially selective/discontinuous in route order rather than being adequately described as a compact contiguous block after fixed-q site propensity and exact activation depth are represented.

secondary_fixed_endpoints: descriptive observed and q-expected topology metrics by exact k=1..10

q_conditioned_null.q_source: Same strongest fixed-q generator used by the ERA5 + strictly-prior SiteID-history + dry-persistence + matched-incidence structural diagnostics.
q_conditioned_null.subset_weights: Probability proportional to product of q/(1-q) odds for included stops.

uncertainty.primary_interval: Route-cluster bootstrap percentile 95% interval for mean cluster-level holes excess.
uncertainty.bootstrap_unit: State x RouteNumber, retaining all eligible taxa/pairs within each sampled route.
uncertainty.null_test: Plus-one upper-tail Monte Carlo probability for the mean primary excess under exact-k fixed-q subset draws.

support_rule.primary_supported: Observed mean holes excess > exact-k null 97.5th percentile, plus-one upper-tail P<0.05, and route-bootstrap 95% lower bound >0.
support_rule.if_not_supported: Do not claim selective/discontinuous route geometry; retain only the RC6 multi-site concentration and route-lag results.

anti_tuning: Do not change the primary k>=4 threshold after readback.
Do not change holes definition, fixed-q source, exact-k conditioning, bootstrap unit, seeds or tails after readback.
Do not substitute repaired latitude/longitude into Stage A.
Do not promote a secondary topology metric if the primary holes endpoint fails.
